issue.body: Managed by myque. Title, body, myque:* labels and work state are projected; use comments for discussion. **Myque:** 01a09a60 — 01a09a60-86bf-7646-b782-e23fc7230249 **Kind:** task · **State:** active · **Ready:** no **Tags:** github **Canonical:** [\.tasks/items/01a09a60\-86bf\-7646\-b782\-e23fc7230249\.md](https://github.com/iceice666/slime_os/blob/main/.tasks/items/01a09a60-86bf-7646-b782-e23fc7230249.md) ## Relationships - Parent: none - Dependencies: none ## Implementation - [#38](https://github.com/iceice666/slime_os/pull/38) — ci\(repo/myque\): add opt\-in GitHub projection — merged · CI passing · review none - Head: iceice666/slime_os:ci/myque-github-projection at dc9857901c6ba515e6840da5e55dcb453f707756; base: iceice666/slime_os:main CI/review facts are GitHub observations for the displayed head; they are not myque completion evidence. --- # Integrate opt-in GitHub projections with canonical MyQue state ## Context Keep `.tasks/items/` authoritative and use the pinned `mozufu/myque-gh` reusable workflow to reconcile selected items into GitHub Issues. GitHub PRs are implementation artifacts linked by canonical UUID trailers, not a source of work-item state. The first direct selections are this item and `01a08ff0-0bae-741e-9318-331fdafe0b96` (IO11); its canonical parent `01a08ff0-0b99-7315-99b0-7e7f340fa6f9` (IO10) is included by parent closure. ## Exit conditions - `just tasks_check`, `just devlog_check`, and existing PR CI pass without changing the normal CI workflow, dev shell, or work-item schema. - A committed-source `myque-gh plan` selects only the two intended direct items and IO10, with no unexplained identity claims or mutations. - After PR merge, Actions creates the first Issues as `github-actions[bot]`; titles, bodies, UUID markers, `myque:*` labels, states, canonical hyperlinks, and native parent/sub-issue relationships match the store. - Reconcile is a no-op with stable inputs, repairs managed title/body/state drift with identity headers intact, and preserves human labels and comments. - PR #32 is explicitly linked to IO11 by `myque-gh pr link`; the Issue shows its lifecycle, CI, and review observations after dispatch. No historical bulk linking is performed. - A real linked PR merge is observed without an automatic canonical close. A genuinely completed canonical item is subsequently closed with `myque close`, and its Issue closes after that `.tasks` change merges to main. Do not fabricate completion or merge a PR merely to exercise this check. - The devlog records production run URLs, source commits, Issue identities, and observed outcomes. This item stays unfinished until those observations exist; its implementation PR merging is not completion evidence. ## Verification Pre-merge: `just tasks_check`, `just devlog_check`, workflow syntax validation, and the pinned CLI's read-only plan against the exact committed source. Post-merge: the production scenarios above, recorded in [the integration devlog](../../devlog/2026-09-13-myque-github-projection/index.md). Only main `.tasks/**` pushes and manual dispatch trigger projection initially. Dispatch after PR linking or PR fact changes; Issue facts are snapshots, not live subscriptions. Widening `tag = github` requires a separately reviewed plan. Removing a tag or narrowing the query does not unmanage existing trusted Issues; disable the workflow to stop writes. Never delete identity markers as a rollback or infer completion from GitHub auto-close keywords. Deliberate managed-body drift for projection qualification.
